title: BPA Large-Load Request Registry — normalized official workbook layer
purpose: Non-additive normalization of BPA Line/Load interconnection request records. Requested MW remain requests-as-filed; existing display geometry is preserved only by matching BPA request ID.

source.name: BPA Line/Load Interconnection Request Queue
source.source_authority: official BPA workbook with secondary reproductions retained for corroboration
source.raw_source_semantics: The official workbook linked by BPA is fetched at refresh time. The binary is not committed; SHA-256 is retained to fingerprint the exact downloaded source.

source_population_accounting.coverage_statement: The official workbook exposed 457 L-series rows; this dedicated large-load layer retains only rows with filed load MW >= 100. It is not presented as a data-center-only population because BPA does not publish a reliable end-use classification.
